messages:
mike_sales: quick heads-upAeroSync wants a 3-week POC for SSO + SCIM + strict domain locking and group->role mapping. they asked about pricing: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. can we scope?

alex_prospect: hi, securityIdP is Okta. we need SAML (IdP-initiated ok), SCIM delta-only preferred, map Okta groups to app roles, enforce tenant domain ownership (no cross-tenant email claims). audit logs + KMS are mandatory.

ana_se: short: SAML + SCIM supported. Console supports group->role mapping and scoped role bindings. domain proofing (TXT) + tenant claim verification available. SCIM supports PATCH/delta and full. will share rate guidance.

kevin_infosec: technical: assertions need NameID + email claim. we support signed assertions, encryption optional (can enable). SP metadata URL pls. cert rotation policy: our default rotate every 90d; Private lets you bring keys/HSM.

sophie_ops: pricing snapshot: short POC best on Hosted unless they need consistent latency or on-prem KMS. Hosted POC: est $1.2k/week + SCIM overage. Dedicated trial (3w) needs a small reserved min, est $3.5k one-time reservation. Private: custom quote (HSM + infra).

mike_sales: @alex_prospect share expected onboarding rates (users/day, SCIM spikes), compliance (SOC2/HIPAA?), and a sample Okta export (groups/users). i'll assemble a POC SOW.

alex_prospect: onboarding: normal 2k new users/week, DAU ~10k. migration spikes up to 5k users/day via SCIM. HIPAA applies. audit retention 1yr.

ana_se: SCIM rate guidance: Hosted default 600 reqs/min, burst to 1200 on Dedicated. recommend PATCH for deltas to reduce payload ~100x. sample PATCH:
```
PATCH /Users/7d7f3
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{ "op": "replace", "path": "emails[type eq \"work\"].value", "value": "jane@aerosync.com" }]
}
```

deploy-bot: infra ticket created INF-4821 3-week Dedicated test node requested (1x A10g equiv) assigned to eng-runtime.

kevin_infosec: questions: need assertion encryption? session timeout < default 60m? SSO login hints? also list of SSO IP allowlist for SP endpoints.

alex_prospect: yes encrypt assertions. session timeout want 15m idle. we'll provide a small allowlist and SP metadata soon.

sophie_ops: hosted audit logs default 90d. enterprise add-on gives 1yr. Dedicated can integrate with customer KMS for key wrap; Private gives full HSM support. will attach SOC2 artifacts and MSA clause template.

mike_sales: action items: 1) aero to provide SP metadata + Okta group export + allowlist, 2) ana to post SCIM throughput + sample configs, 3) sophie to send POC pricing sheet (hosted vs dedicated vs private) + SOC2 links, 4) infra to provision test node (INF-4821). i'll send SOW draft by EOD.

ana_se: added: RBAC can be done via group->role mapping in Console and via SCIM group sync. can set canary access for new roles. will add a sample mapping snippet.

sophie_ops: i'll DM the detailed numbers and draft contract notes. for HIPAA we recommend Dedicated or Private for BAAs; Hosted can be reviewed case-by-case.

mike_sales: thanks team I'll consolidate and loop in AeroSync legal/infosec. :thumbsup:
